title: Fundamentals of Screening in Breast Imaging
use: Build your search pattern, localization and screening framework.

title: Fundamentals of Diagnostic Breast Imaging
use: First 59-minute teaching block, then selected 43-minute case block. Target symptoms and workup views first.

title: Fundamentals of Management of Breast Findings
use: Calcifications, masses, asymmetries, US cystic findings, MRI and nodes. Split into short topic blocks.

title: Fundamentals of Breast Pathology
use: Pair with Absolute chapter 7 and radiology-pathology concordance.

title: Fundamentals of US Regulatory/Standards of Care in Breast Imaging
use: Review reporting, density notification and audit after the clinical basics; verify regulations with FDA.

title: Fundamentals of Breast Physics
use: Short physics refresher; useful during screening and for the unbuilt physics quizzes.

title: Breast Biopsy (Ultrasound-Guided)
use: Planning 15 min, positioning 10 min, technique 30 min, aftercare 7 min; spread across procedure days.

title: Breast Biopsy (Stereotactic/Tomosynthesis-Guided)
use: Technique block 19 min; complications 9 min; case example 17 min.

title: Breast Biopsy (MRI-Guided)
use: Use before an MRI biopsy day, rather than as pre-rotation mandatory viewing.

title: Breast Tomosynthesis (DBT)
use: Select search pattern/localization, asymmetries, distortion and calcifications. Save the full course for later.

title: Digital Breast Tomosynthesis Cases
use: 43 quiz questions on 15 DICOM files. Video time excludes case interpretation.

title: Diagnostic Breast Imaging (Mammo, Tomo, Ultrasound)
use: Longer second pass for weaknesses; overlaps the fundamentals sequence.

title: Digital Breast Tomosynthesis and Tomosynthesis Guided Biopsy Expert Case Review
use: Bridge DBT findings to biopsy targeting.

title: BI-RADS 3 on MRI, Ultrasound, Mammography
use: Practice appropriate use of probably benign assessment, with current ACR wording beside you.

title: Breast Imaging Overview Expert Case Review
use: A compact mixed-case refresh after your baseline.

title: Breast Imaging Diagnostic Workup and Management Expert Case Review
use: Use when deciding the next view or next step remains difficult.

title: Screening & Evaluation of Findings in Breast Imaging Expert Case Review
use: A short case-based option on a screening-heavy week.

title: Breast Calcifications Expert Case Review
use: Targeted visual review; translate older descriptors with the v2025 summary.

title: Challenging Breast Cases Expert Case Review
use: Use after common cases and management feel comfortable.

title: Avoiding Mistakes & Managing Complications in Breast Imaging Expert Case Review
use: Useful during procedure week and when reviewing near misses.

title: Breast MRI
use: Selective primer before MRI days; avoid making the entire course a barrier to starting.

title: High Risk Screening Breast MRI
use: Risk-based screening and MRI cases.

title: Breast MRI Expert Case Review
use: Active interpretation practice after the MRI primer.

title: Abbreviated Breast MR
use: Practice-specific supplement.

title: Evaluation of Newly Diagnosed, Pre-Operative Breast Cancer Patients
use: Fills part of the unbuilt Absolute chapter 10 gap.

title: Breast Implant Imaging Evaluation
use: Useful bridge while Absolute chapter 9 is not built.

title: Contrast-Enhanced Mammography
use: Move up only if your service uses CEM; use the ACR v2025 CEM lexicon.

title: Practical Application of AI in Breast Imaging
use: Low priority for getting ready for day one.

title: Breast Imaging Noon Conference
use: Search by a question from the day; not a linear assignment.
